statement: NVIDIA B300 single-GPU purchase price is quoted at roughly $53,000 per GPU
why: A point-in-time hardware price level for the current top-end part, with no baseline given for comparison.

impact.mechanism: Sets the per-accelerator capital cost reference for current-generation buys; static level only, no change stated.

evidence.source: aggregated web search (IntuitionLabs, GPU Battle, JarvisLabs, getdeploying.com)
evidence.excerpt: single-GPU purchase price quoted as 'roughly $53,000 per GPU'

confidence.basis: Secondary trade/pricing-guide aggregation, no vendor confirmation and no stated as-of date.

dispersion: 8-GPU DGX B300 quoted $400,000-$500,000; 72-GPU GB300 NVL72 rack quoted $3,000,000-$4,000,000, about $41,700-$55,600 per GPU implied.
